div.div:
Who calls whom
The API server calls KEDA's metrics API directly, so that pod has no Istio sidecar. It reads each value from the operator over gRPC, with KEDA's own TLS, on port 9666 (PERMISSIVE). The operator queries Prometheus through its sidecar: Prometheus accepts mTLS only, and namespace keda is one of its allowed callers. KEDA answers with the query's total; the HPA divides it by the pods. CPU never passes through KEDA.
